node.label: juvenile nephropathic cystinosis
node.definition: Nephropathic juvenile cystinosis is the intermediate form, in regards to severity and age of onset, of cystinosis, a metabolic disease characterized by an accumulation of cystine inside the lysosomes that causes damage in different organs and tissues, particularly in the kidneys and eyes.
synonyms: cystinosis, late-onset juvenile or adolescent nephropathic

mechanism_classes.label: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails)
amino acid / organic acid metabolism
mechanism_classes.via_label: inborn disorder of amino acid metabolism
